homeTitle: A little care for your island.
homeDescription: Organize your pockets, look after your island, and make every edit clear.
dropHint: Save folder, main.dat, or ZIP archive
howTitle: Your first edit, in three steps
step1Body: Choose an exported save folder or main.dat. Keep its companion files together.
step2Body: Choose a player, select a slot, and edit with clear controls.
step3Body: Edits stay in memory until you save. Automatic backups follow your existing settings.
localNote: Files are processed on this computer.
recent: Pick up where you left off
noRecent: Your most recent save will appear here.
playerHint: Edit names, balances and capacity. Changes stay in memory until you save.
applied: Changes applied. Save to file when ready.
inventoryHint: Select a slot to inspect or replace an item. Changes can be undone.
searchInventory: Find an item in this inventory
selectSlotHint: Select an item or an empty slot to begin.
quantityHint: The limit follows this item's stack size.
catalogHint: Browse all items by category or search by name / ID. After choosing, apply the change in Item details.
toolsTitle: More ways to care for your island
toolsHint: These tools open in the original editor while the new workspace grows.
legacyHint: Full map, villager, design, import, export and console tools remain in the original editor. Opening it starts a new undo history.
busy: Another operation is in progress. Please try again.
operationFailed: The operation could not be completed.
invalidRequest: Check the values and selected slot, then try again.
unsavedPrompt: Save your changes before leaving? Yes saves, No discards, Cancel keeps editing.
runtimeMissing: The new workspace could not start. Install Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, or use the original editor below.
missingAssets: Workspace files are missing. Rebuild the app with npm and the .NET SDK.
offlinePreview: Browser preview · open NHSE on Windows to edit real saves.
overviewHint: Choose what you would like to work on. Your existing island tools are always nearby.
keyHints: Ctrl+S save · Ctrl+Z undo · F11 full screen
nameHint: Up to 10 characters; some emoji use two positions.
islandNameHint: Updates references to this island throughout the save.
villagerCatalogHint: Choose your current resident, then browse portraits by species, personality or name.
chooseVillagerHint: Select a portrait to preview the replacement.
villagerReplaceHint: Replacing loads the villager’s default profile and house. Save in the main editor when ready.
villagerHouseMissing: This resident has no matching house. Check the island’s house assignments first.
residentEditHint: Choose a portrait to edit the resident. Changes can be undone; save when ready.
oldResidentFormat: This older save supports profile editing. Gallery replacement requires a newer save format.
catchphraseHint: Up to 24 characters; some emoji use two positions. Can be left empty.
movingOutHint: This marks the resident as moving out. Apply only when you intend them to leave.
noResidents: There are no residents in this save.
islandSettingsHint: Edit island settings here. Terrain, buildings and designs are available through the specialized editors below.
weatherSeedHint: A seed determines the weather pattern. Retain the current value unless you want to change that pattern.
mapEditorHint: Open terrain, buildings, houses, campsite and island tools.
designEditorHint: Edit patterns, PRO designs, the island flag and tailor designs.
islandToolNames: Terrain & buildings|Player houses|Resident houses|Campsite|Fruit & flowers|Recycle box|Turnip prices
specializedHint: Opens the specialized editor directly. Changes join this workspace’s undo history; save when ready.
turnipFeverHint: Raw game value; keep it unchanged unless you know the intended value.
turnipHint: Edit the weekly prices in memory. Apply changes or save to include them in the shared undo history. Sunday sell values are retained for completeness.
progressHint: Edit the selected player’s records. Valid drafts apply when saving, navigating or switching players.
progressReactionHint: Reactions retain their saved slot order and wheel assignments. Labels use the game IDs and enum names; unused IDs are available for advanced editing.
progressMilestoneHint: Blank dates mean unset. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. All six stored milestones remain editable, including internal fields.
progressBatchHint: This changes the entire list for the selected player, including entries outside the search. One undo restores the operation.
housingHint: Edit house settings, rooms and island life. Valid drafts apply on save or navigation; undo and redo remain shared.
housingCampLocked: The campsite is not unlocked in this save.
housingCampHint: Visitor selection preserves the saved visit date. Clearing occupancy removes the visitor without changing the date.
housingFruitHint: Profile fruit belongs to the selected player. Changing native island fruit also updates its five fruit flags.
housingLayers: Floor|Supported floor items|North wall|West wall|South wall|East wall|Rugs|Ceiling
housingRoomHint: Select a tile, choose an item and apply. Multi-tile items keep their extension tiles together. Placement must stay inside the 20×20 grid; overlap is blocked when protection is enabled.
roomPlacementBlocked: This item cannot be placed here: check the room boundary and occupied tiles.
housingFieldNames: House level|House status|Wall|Roof|Door|Ordered wall|Ordered roof|Ordered door|Loan|Unknown value|Resident 1|Resident 2|Builder player|Player house flag|House flag|Door decoration|Mailbox|Ordered mailbox|Extra item|Item ID|System parameter|Additional parameter|Free parameter|Occupied|Visitor|Visit date|Player profile fruit|Native island fruit|Sister fruit|Native flower|Sister flower
designWorkspaceHint: Preview ordinary designs, PRO designs, the island flag and tailor designs. Imported designs join the shared undo history; save the workspace to write them to disk.
designOwnershipHint: This choice applies to single and batch imports. Using the selected player updates only the town and player identity fields.
designFileHint: Ordinary designs and flags use .nhd; PRO and tailor designs use .nhpd. Batch exports include slot numbers to distinguish identical names.
designBatchHint: Files are sorted by filename and replace slots starting at slot 1, regardless of the selection or search. The entire batch is one undo step. Invalid sizes or too many files leave every slot unchanged.
designFileSize: The design file size does not match this design type. No designs were changed.
designCapacity: There are more design files than available slots. No designs were changed.
designNoFiles: No matching design files were found in the selected folder.
mapSlotHint: Slots are indexed records; they do not indicate a position on this preview.
mapSnap: Align field objects to whole tiles
mapOutside: This cell is outside the editable area.
mapFieldNames: Terrain shape|Terrain variant|Terrain rotation|Path shape|Path variant|Path rotation|Elevation|Building|X coordinate|Y coordinate|Angle|Flags|Type|Type argument|Unique ID|Reserved value|Acre template|Plaza X|Plaza Y|Exterior template|Main field template|Design value
mapBrushHint: Apply the current terrain fields around the selected cell. One application is one undo step.
mapInteriorOnly: Skip the outer ring of terrain acres
mapFootprintHint: Removing a multi-cell object also clears its root and footprint, including cells across acre boundaries.
mapFileHint: Raw files preserve item parameters. Changing map width requires confirmation before conversion.
mapBatchHint: This replaces data in the indicated area. You can undo the operation in one step.
mapConvertConfirm: Convert to the current save layout? Width conversion may discard outer columns. Legacy building files keep the last six buildings unchanged.
mapFileSize: The file size does not match a supported map format.
mapInvalidAcre: This acre is outside the editable area for this layer.
mapItemOperations: Remove weeds|Remove trees|Fill holes|Remove plants|Remove fences|Remove field objects|Remove all items|Remove placed items|Remove shells|Remove branches|Remove flowers|Remove bushes|Water flowers|Water flowers with all watering flags
mapTerrainOperations: Set terrain from current fields|Set paths from current fields|Set elevation to zero
mapNhiSize: NHI files must contain 1–10,000 complete 8-byte items.
mapInvalidRule: A batch rule has an invalid property, operator or value.
mapInvalidItem: Choose a valid root item; empty and extension records cannot be placed.
mapSpawnLimit: The source is empty or exceeds 10,000 generated objects.
mapSpawnHint: Start at the selected cell and skip occupied positions. Generation stays in the selected layer and stops at the edge. Counts repeat the entire source; construction-kit recipes are excluded.
mapSpawnSources: Current item fields|Recipes by ID|Recipes by name|Inventory file (.nhi)
mapParameterHint: Conditions match root objects only. All changes and footprints are checked before applying; a collision rejects the entire operation. Numeric values use exact decimal text. Replacement matches the selected object including all raw parameters.
mapReplaceMatches: Replace matching objects with current fields
mapParamNames: Raw 64-bit value|Rotation|Buried|Dropped|Stack count|Use count|Body variant|Pattern source|Pattern choice|Days watered|Watered|Gold-watered|Flower genes|Wrapping type|Wrapping paper|Show wrapped item|Wrapping flag 80|Wrapped|Display item ID|Empty|Extension|Root object|Field object|Record size
mapDragHint: Fields become the brush template. Drag on the acre preview; release to apply one undoable stroke. Escape or pointer cancellation discards the stroke. Navigation does not apply the template to the selected cell.
gridSelectionHelp: Drag to select a rectangle. Ctrl/Cmd-click toggles cells; Shift-click extends a rectangle. Ctrl/Cmd+A selects this grid. Arrows move; Shift+arrows extend. Ctrl/Cmd+C/V copies/pastes; Delete clears; R rotates; Esc cancels. In brush mode, hold Shift to select. Text fields keep their normal shortcuts.
gridClipboardHelp: The editor clipboard is shared within the current save. Copy uses applied values, includes whole objects and skips empty cells. One object fills the selection by its footprint; multiple records retain their layout. Paste and clear each use one undo step; bounds and overlap checks still apply.
gridEmptyCopy: There are no objects to copy in this selection.
gridTypeMismatch: Terrain and object clipboards cannot be mixed.
gridRoomItem: Field objects cannot be pasted into a room.
gridCopied: Selection copied to the editor clipboard.
housingFileHint: Import replaces the selected house or the entire selected room, including every layer. House assignments are kept. Valid drafts apply first; imports can be undone.
housingConvertConfirm: This file uses a different save version. Convert it to this save format? Fields unavailable in the target version may be lost.
housingFileSize: This file is not a compatible house or room file.
museumHint: Edit all 1,024 island donation records. Changes join shared undo and are written only on Save.
museumSearch: Search records, items, dates or donors
museumDateHint: Leave blank for an unset date. Stored date:
museumBatchHint: This affects the whole island museum, including records outside the current search. Import replaces all records. Adding missing donations uses genuine art and the original species lists, donor 0 and the next donation date. Each operation can be undone.
museumFileSize: The museum file must be exactly 13,316 bytes.
museumDateInvalid: Enter a valid donation date. Sorting and adding donations require valid stored dates and room for the next date.
museumCapacity: There are not enough empty donation records.
